title: Conduit deployment manifest
description: Shape defined by CONDUIT_PRD_v1.0.md section 17.3. Every deployment writes one manifest here; PRD FR-014 requires the public verifier to consume it without trusting the application database.

deploymentId.description: Domain separator bound into every intent and every cross-chain message header.

solcVersion.description: Exact compiler, never a range. Must equal toolchain.json solidity.solc.

bytecodeHashes.description: keccak256 of deployed runtime bytecode, recomputable from source because foundry.toml sets bytecode_hash=none and cbor_metadata=false.

cleanverseAssetSnapshotHash.description: Hash of the signed query_deposit_atoken_list snapshot. PRD 2.4 forbids hardcoded A-Token addresses.

validatorRuleHashes.description: Hash of the normalized Cleanverse validator/rules response per registered pool. PRD 9.6 forbids reinterpreting the rules locally.

timestamp.description: UTC, per the CLAUDE.md repository rules.

finalityProfile.description: Minimum Wormhole finality Conduit enforces per message class, bound into the bytecode as an immutable. PRD FR-014 lets a verifier bootstrap from this manifest, and which profile is live is a security property rather than a tuning detail: an authentic VAA below the settlement level is refused, because parseAndVerifyVM proves guardians signed a message and not that the source state is irreversible.

settlement.description: Required for every message that authorizes an irreversible economic outcome.

observation.description: Required for messages that inform rather than authorize.
